scope: Completed independent code/evidence review of scoped live-monitor software correctness and UI handoff; scientific uncertainty/convergence remains unestablished.
preflight: proceed; six passes; no blocking preflight gates

findings.finding: Ordinal residue matching maps a selected atom to another same-sequence chain when explicit chain IDs were swapped.
findings.certainty: Reproduced helper behavior on synthetic topology; no native engine chain reorder observed.
findings.required: Reject explicit chain mismatch and verify retained coordinate correspondence before engine recentering when chain IDs disappear.

findings.status: resolved; synthetic truncate/regrow and native stop/resume passed
findings.finding: A hard-stopped engine may have full XTC samples after its checkpoint; append can truncate and regrow the same file.
findings.certainty: Risk addressed by synthetic file-regeneration controls and observed native stop/resume outputs.
findings.required: Test truncation/regrowth, reset or rebuild consumed cursor, and compare final prefix/time/values with offline native trajectory.

findings.status: resolved in code; injected monitor failure regression passes
findings.finding: Runtime identity/geometry/read errors must be reported by the optional monitor without failing MD.
findings.certainty: Safe worker wrappers inspected and injected monitor-failure regression passed.
findings.required: Injected monitor failures preserve simulation completion and outputs; invalid initial selections can reject submission.

findings.finding: Ordinary loadDataset clears plots/camera and may asynchronously inject a default measurement; stale water callback can mutate another dataset.
findings.certainty: Reviewed guarded final implementation and passed native-result event-delivery browser controls.
findings.required: Complete remapped workspace restoration under dataset/session/load generation guard; no late plot or visibility mutation on other views.
findings.resolution_evidence: browser-regression.json: automatic handoff, alternate-scene camera/measurements/visibility unchanged, in-flight completion cannot overwrite New, real preparation and solvation preserve the tracked selection; warning setter has load/session guard

findings.status: resolved for engine translation; analytic and browser checks passed
findings.finding: Each dataset is displayed relative to its own first-frame coordinates, while GROMACS recenters into a periodic box; copying camera numbers need not preserve molecular focus.
findings.certainty: Independent analytic control and installed NGL source confirm translation correction; browser validates restored camera. Arbitrary rigid reorientation or changed biological focus is outside this feature.
findings.required: Verify a translated source-to-output example and use mapped-atom display/camera correction or an explicit preserved focus strategy.
findings.resolution_evidence: review-camera-control.json verifies translated frames and installed NGL convention; browser-regression.json preserves final camera rotation/zoom and final-frame workspace

findings.finding: Workspace measurement whitelist drops new tracking fields; a solvation record alone does not establish current water visibility.
findings.certainty: Validated workspace whitelist and current text inspected; real API browser persistence and water visibility controls passed.
findings.required: Persist validated tracking choices if intended across reload and describe saved water versus visible water accurately.
findings.resolution_evidence: browser-regression.json: tracking choices survive mode changes/reload, explicit water is an accessible setup stage, real water hide/show changes canvas; title accurately describes saved box readiness

findings.finding: Pre-integration identity tolerance rejects 70/76 retained CA coordinates in an existing real GROMACS setup because normal GRO rounding exceeds 0.0002 nm.
findings.certainty: Reproduced with previously completed isolated native job; no new MD.
findings.required: Use a format-aware finite per-axis tolerance and test normal rounding against actual coordinate/order changes.

findings.finding: An in-memory identity error is lost across worker restart. A disabled initial monitor could otherwise become active after resume without the original verification.
findings.certainty: Failed-proof preservation was independently reproduced on fresh and resumed Worker paths.
findings.required: Persist identity proof/failure with traceable native mapping/topology state and retain its verdict on Resume.

findings.finding: Deferred completion and job-card Explore originally used a plain dataset open, dropping the run measurements when the source was no longer selected.
findings.required: Load the completed job snapshot and its verified output atom mappings; retain that run’s plots without copying a different dataset’s state.
findings.certainty: Read-only integration review; root now routes manual opening through completed-run workspace restoration.
findings.resolution_evidence: browser-regression.json and browser-validation.json: explicit Open trajectory after another scene was retained restores all three verified native plots

findings.finding: Restoring up to 100 workspace plots concurrently can multiply the physical-trajectory memory budget.
findings.required: Bound restoration work per dataset/physical trajectory.
findings.certainty: Inspected the previous Promise.all restoration and current sequential preview loop.
